message.content:
# OpenAI Meeting Briefing (November 20, 2026)

## Recent developments
* **Introduction of ChatGPT Wallet:** OpenAI launched ChatGPT Wallet in November 2026 to support agentic payments, allowing authorized users (initially US ChatGPT Pro subscribers) to complete transactions via agent capabilities [4].
* **Images 2.6 Release:** OpenAI released Images 2.6 in November 2026, offering faster iteration and editing control across ChatGPT, Codex, and API tiers (including variants like GPT-Image-2.6 Sunburst and Flare) [2].
* **Model Spec Update:** OpenAI published an updated Model Spec in late October/November 2026, organizing safety and capability standards around core values [3].
* **Web Preferences Signal:** OpenAI announced support for a common signal allowing website operators to communicate AI training preferences across multiple AI providers [1].
* **Enterprise and Geographic Expansions:** OpenAI expanded enterprise workflow partnerships (such as with ServiceNow and Oracle), integrated ChatGPT Work into Uber [1], and expanded ChatGPT Ads to 26 new countries [5].

## Talking points
* **Agentic Commerce & Payments:** Discuss the roadmap, security frameworks, and bank/network integrations surrounding ChatGPT Wallet [4].
* **Creative and Visual Tooling:** Address the enterprise and developer integration opportunities stemming from the Images 2.6 rollout [2].
* **Enterprise Scaling & Partnerships:** Review progress and feedback from recent platform expansions, including enterprise integrations (Oracle, ServiceNow, Uber) [1] and global advertising rollouts [5].
* **Governance and Standards:** Discuss how the updated Model Spec [3] and new web training preference signals [1] impact data governance and compliance.

## Open questions
* What is the broader timeline for rolling out ChatGPT Wallet beyond initial US Pro subscribers and payment partners [4]?
* How are enterprise customers adopting the recent workflow and application expansions with partners like Oracle and ServiceNow [1]?
* What metrics or early signals are emerging from the recent global expansion of ChatGPT Ads [5]?
* How will the new web training preference standard be monitored and adopted industry-wide [1]?

## Sources
* [1] OpenAI - Making it easier for websites to express AI training preferences: https://openai.com/index/helping-websites-express-ai-training-preferences
* [2] OpenAI - Introducing Images 2.6: https://openai.com/index/introducing-images-2-6
* [3] OpenAI - An updated Model Spec for more capable and beneficial AI: https://openai.com/index/updated-model-spec
* [4] OpenAI - Introducing ChatGPT Wallet: https://openai.com/index/introducing-chatgpt-wallet
* [5] OpenAI - ChatGPT Ads expands to 26 new countries: https://openai.com/index/chatgpt-ads-expands-26-new-countries
